description: Continuous high methane concentration detected near Sector 4 working face. Sensor reading is at 2.5% exceeding statutory limits. Immediate evacuation in process.
Noticeable bending and structural stress on two hydraulic roof supports in Gallery B. Minor rockfall observed in the last hour. Work stopped temporarily.
The main conveyor belt near transfer point 3 is showing significant wear and fraying on the edges. Needs maintenance before the next shift to prevent tearing and friction fires.
Sudden heavy water seepage detected from the eastern coal seam wall. Water level in Gallery 3 has risen by 15 inches in the last 20 minutes. Main drainage pumps are currently overwhelmed.
Primary exhaust fan for Sector 7 has unexpectedly shut down. Airflow has dropped below statutory limits, risking a buildup of noxious gases. Miners have been instructed to pause blasting operations.
Exposed high-voltage cables near the main transformer station are actively sparking. High risk of ignition due to the presence of airborne coal dust in the vicinity.
Significant buildup of combustible coal dust observed on the floor and side ribs of Haulage Road B. The area requires immediate stone-dusting (rock dusting) to mitigate explosion risks.
